notes.title: Welcome to Online Co-op in the ‘Fellowship Sanctuary’ update!
notes.notes:
Hello Family!

The day you all have been patiently waiting for has finally come. Today Children of Morta gets its most anticipated free update - the online co-op. What’s more - everyone willing to try it can now download the game for free on Steam for a limited time.

You know it’s better to face challenges together. See this in the trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JrvARwiOW0o

The heroic Bergson family began their epic journey with the launch of Children of Morta in September 2019, and the online co-op update marks the eighth and final stop on the game’s Development Roadmap. Previous  updates introduced new difficulty levels, the Family Trails mode, a new playable character, and more. In addition, the ‘Paws and Claws’ charity DLC helped raise thousands of dollars for Humane Society International. Now, the Online Co-op update is available for all players for free (note the console version is still in the works).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/71a410e3fb5b638aea139ca60f1083f69bebc56f.jpg

The introduction of an online co-op means that noble warriors from distant lands can fight side by side, and those brave enough to pick up against the Corruption can foretaste this adventure without any cost. If you’re willing to invite to a co-op session a friend who doesn’t have the game in his Steam library, then Children of Morta will be available for free to try on Steam between February 14th at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT, 1 PM ET) and February 18th at 7 PM CET (10 AM PT, 1 PM ET).

For those enjoying monster-slaying during the free period, Children of Morta will be significantly discounted with minus 65% for the base game, and minus 60% for the Complete Edition, containing also both paid DLC-s (Paws and Claws charity DLC/Ancient Spirits new character DLC).

Finally, the Onlice Co-op is available in both game modes - Story and Family Trials!

Best,
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

notes.title: The awaited Co-op Update "The Fellowship Sanctuary" comes on Feb. 14th!
notes.notes:
Hello Family!

11 bit studios and Dead Mage will mark the last update on the Children of Morta Development Roadmap with the release of The Fellowship Sanctuary on Steam on Feb. 14th, 2022. The final of a whopping 8 free updates to the successful rogue-lite adventure is highlighted by the long-awaited online co-op mode allowing for two valiant warriors to team up against the ever-oppressive Corruption together.

Have a bit of upcoming fun in the teaser here! https://youtu.be/iMxgXnp7-1U

While Steam players will be able to enjoy online co-op on Feb. 14th, the Dead Mage team is still hard at work on bringing the same experience to consoles. In efforts to assure the same quality across all platforms, the development team is adamant to get everything right before releasing it. We don’t currently have a release window on this update, but endeavor to keep all our valuable console players in the know as development continues. We truly appreciate our community’s continued patience and support in this matter.

Alongside the Feb. 14th release, Children of Morta will be enjoying a free-to-play offer on Steam so anyone can try the game for themselves.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/fac0da51532159a0257f3b2e471b4f5aa2ede036.jpg

It’s been nearly 2 years since the game launch and the initial Kickstarter that started it all. Without our dear Backers then, we wouldn’t be able to talk to you now, all the less provide the gaming experience you’ve been fans of ever since our launch in 2019!

Here are some words from the team themselves:

Thank you for your belief in us and the journey Children of Morta has been going through ever since the fundraiser - you’re an integral part of it and we are delighted to deliver additional content to you today! We hope you enjoy all of the below and look forward to more news from us in terms of Children of Morta - there are still more things to come, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Children of Morta | Community Update - March 2021
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/34ee2564918b9638e9c54fbe64e2b2325579e099.jpg

Hi there, Family!

We hope that the year 2021 has treated you well so far. We are doing great but we’re also quite busy. What are we cooking, you ask? Well, some content for Children of Morta, obviously! Lands of Rea are rather dangerous in some places - that’s why from time to time it is wise to create a detour in your travels. And it’s especially nice if you find some unexpected rewards while discovering new routes, right? So that’s exactly what we did. Here’s a quick summary of our adventures from 2020 and some plans for 2021. 

 « THE STORY SO FAR » 
2020 was a tough year for all of us. A global pandemic, social unrest, major natural disasters. Everyone copes with tough situations differently - and we happen to be a bunch of proper gaming [strike]nerds[/strike] aficionados, so that’s what we have focused on: making stuff for our game for you to enjoy. We hope that by creating new content for Children of Morta we’ve provided you with a portion of much-needed escapism. In 2020, we have delivered 5 significant updates to the game and four of them were completely free. Through those updates, we’ve added things like Items Packs, New Game+ Mode, new difficulty settings, a brand new playable character, and more! 

The paid DLC, however, was a different story and was very special for us - ‘cause it gave a spotlight to something that we care about deeply: our animal friends. Paws and Claws DLC - while it obviously adds new features to the game (like the Animal Shelter System, new boosts, animations and events) -  it first and foremost focuses on helping animals in the real world. 100% of 11 bit studios and Dead Mage's proceeds from selling this piece of content go to the Humane Society International charity organization. We’re super proud to announce that this way we’ve already raised more than $100k (and this number is still growing!) for animals around the world - and it’s all thanks to you! Thank you so much for supporting Paws and Claws DLC, folks!

Now, let’s see what the future holds for us, shall we? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/b132b795ac1c4860bc4e67ec6ed158e063a2612e.jpg
Click here for a full-sized map.

 « NEW ROUTES ON  THE ROADMAP » 
As you can see, there are some alterations to our route and we’d like to shed some light on what happened here and what we had to change over the course of the last few months.

Our initial plan for the last three updates was simple: 1) deliver a rather straightforward and basic endless mode for the game; 2) then add the online co-op functionality and last but not least - 3) create a bigger piece of paid content that would feel like a separate mode of the game. Those were the three upcoming points on our previous roadmap. However, what we have learned by creating the Uncharted Lands (paid DLC) - is that it would organically work better if we have actually merged some of its features with the Endless Mode, delivering a brand new experience in a shorter amount of time. A win-win situation, so to speak.

Let us be fully transparent here: we kinda felt that the basic endless mode (The Temple of The Endless Update on the roadmap) that we’ve implemented and tested back in the day didn’t add that much to the game. It was functional, you would’ve enjoyed it for sure - but it wasn’t a major game-changer. We felt it’s not enough - even as a fun little free update. But by borrowing some mechanics from the paid DLC content - we could’ve created something special that almost feels like a game within a game. So... that’s exactly what we did. That’s how the Family Trials Mode was born! 

And there’s a surprise here, too. Even though it was supposed to be a paid DLC, we decided to make it totally free to thank you all for supporting us by buying the game and the Paws and Claws Charity DLC.

 » Long story short: there is no paid DLC coming anymore at a later stage - instead of that you’re getting a bigger, super fun, free content update in the form of Family Trials Mode.

We’re going to share more information about the new content later down the road. But we don’t want to leave you empty-handed so for now, here’s a sneak peek of the totally new hub area that will welcome you to the Family Trials Mode:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/98800fb0ef6983610d08b5a1704854482657990a.jpg
Click here to see the high-resolution version (and set it as your wallpaper, preferably).

Oh, you would like to see more? Ok, ok, fine, here’s a short teaser, then:
https://youtu.be/Q6wpq3tTInk

 « ONLINE CO-OP » 
We know you’re all waiting for the online co-op functionality to be added to Children of Morta. Believe us, we want to see you wreaking havoc on your enemies without the restraints of the local co-op, too - but the only thing we can confirm at the moment is that we’re still working on it, it’s not canceled or anything like that. We can’t give you any dates here. The only new piece of info is that the upcoming Family Trials Mode will also use that online co-op support in the future.

Okay, Fam, that’s all the news that we have for you today! If you would like to stay up to date with everything we do, please follow us on Twitter and Facebook. Stay safe and awesome!

Cheers,
Dead Mage and 11 bit studios

notes.title: Bergsons' House - New Character Added! | Free Content Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/72f1db0ea39cf7f102465ed4836e2f95d6029314.jpg

Hi there, Family!

We bring you some news from far-away lands! Bergsons’ House Update introduces a brand-new hero: Apan, a versatile mid-range champion, capable of covering a large area with her staff and spells while using a set of all-new runes and skills. Learn more about her story and skills from our latest video: https://youtu.be/R5UruY0FgPI

Apan’s Introduction - Story: 
Among the Asva tribe, she is known as “Clan Mother”. She was barely out of childhood when her talent for healing started to show. As a youth, she would participate in her tribe’s battles to treat and nurse the soldiers but wasn’t above picking up a weapon and fight when it was called for.

In one of those wars, she nursed to health a young warrior named Dhal, the son of their tribe chief, from critical wounds. They started courting and got married on the midsummer day, under the lucky shade of willows. As a gift, on their marriage day, Dhal gave Apan a magical dragon-shaped flying kite, upon which she could ride over the entire lands of the north in a day and a night.

Years later, when she spied the amassed pitch-black clouds in the distant south, she decided that she was needed in the midlands, and she arrived there to give aid to the Bergsons in their fight against the Corruption.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/53894f09d06162dc828cfa372e506d6fbb1169b7.png

Apan’s Introduction - Gameplay: 
Apan is as skilled in providing vital support for the companions on the battlefield as in wielding a sturdy staff. Weapons’ reach makes Apan perfect for delivering deadly mid-range strikes and her special Asva Pulse dash ability leaves the opponents hindered in the dust. Her spells cover a large area of effect, and all the Bergsons can take advantage from Apan’s medical knowledge as she boosts the effects of the healing potions. Also, a new system lets the family gain shields from items, abilities, and Apan’s Rage skill. In other words - her presence makes them all stronger, especially in the battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/505e3972f25e1af156bf338a5e2af858462c1466.png

Apan’s Introduction - Origins:
We're also super happy to say that the new character design was done by a backer and his partner from the game’s Kickstarter campaign! They believed in our project since the very early stage and we are super thankful for that! Here's what these backers - known as AgaRar and GlueBubble - had to say about the idea that inspired the Apan's creation: “The idea for Apan came from the brainstorming of myself and my partner. We originally made her an orphan but later changed her to a mother to better compliment the Children of Morta story and family theme. A strong leader of nomadic healers who allies herself with the Bergsons to aid them in their fight against Corruption. We hope that our inspiration and Dead Mage's hard work translates into a character that you all will enjoy for years to come.”.

General features list:
Bergsons’ House Update is now available on all platforms: Xbox One, PC (Steam, GOG.com, Humble Store), PS4 and Nintendo Switch. The free update contains:

 A brand-new character with a unique skillset designed to play in single-player, but shine in co-op playthroughs
 Special shielding skills and passive healing mechanics
 32 new Apan-specific Runes
 9 new story Cutscenes
 a few HUD and UI tweaks
 additional bug fixes

We hope you like this new addition to the Bergsons' family! Be sure to let us know what you think in the comments!

Full change log = even more details: 
And last but not least, here's the detailed list of all new features, changes, tweaks and fixes. As usual, some of those may contain some super small hints/spoilers about the game's lore - but nothing to be really alarmed about!

Main Apan skills:
Asva Thunderclap
Apan focuses the energy around her and releases it at enemies to push back, slow, and damage them.

Magic Glyph
Using her staff, Apan channels energy around her, creating an area that damages and slows enemies in it.

Guardian’s Rage
Apan unleashes her rage at a protective manner, granting shield to herself and the Bergsons around her.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/761dca13ef48cad0f41b7dbd28695775759d7046.jpg

Added 32 Apan-specific Runes and 6 new Runes for other Bergsons to aid them in combat:

 Apan Trait for Linda: the primary critical attack has a chance to gain a shield
 Apan Trait for Kevin: Kevin gains shield when he exits shadow dance
 Apan Trait for John: the primary attack has a chance to gain a shield
 Apan Trait for Lucy: when lucy uses her decoy, she gains a shield
 Apan Trait for Mark: marks gains shield when he uses his stick
 Apan Trait for Joey: joey's smite gives him a shield

Added new Shield System:

 Bergsons can gain shield now, from items, abilities and Apan’s Guardian Rage skill
 The shield will add on top of HP bar in HUD with an indicator of the amount of shield
 Shields are temporary and can stack up
 When characters have shield all of the receiving damages will be blocked by it till the shield amount ends or shield duration finished.
 Lucy Guardian Rage skill will now add her Shield instead of increasing her maximum health

Added new Rage Globes drop:
Added new Rage Globes drop - refill your rage meter faster! Rage Globes drop with the similar rules as Health Globes. Note: Rage Globes will be added to Nintendo Switch version of the game in a few days, so don’t be alarmed if you don’t see it there, yet!

HUD Tooltip Rework:
 Buff panel now supports and shows more character buffs, including the passive skill of characters skill tree
 Buffs now auto-scroll when players have more than 9 buffs in normal HUD size and 7 buffs in Larger HUD
 Divine Grace tooltip also will auto-scroll when players have more than 8 relics
 Runes are now visible on the minimap

UI changes:

 Added HP indicator for Decoys and Totem Divine Relics
 Added Time indicator for Decoys and Totem Divine Relics

Bug fixes:

 Fixed several issues with Gambler prompts 
 Fixed missing narration for Goblin King event in Magma dungeon 
 Fixed several issues with texts overlap on the UI
 Fixed rocket targeting in Magma Dungeon 
 Fixed the issue where the first dungeon of a Chapter was always highlighted upon opening the Dungeon selection screen
 Increased spawn rate for Stones required for Wine Machine event
 Several additional small bugfixes

How to unlock the new character (minor spoilers):
[olist]
 Apan will be unlocked after watching her intro cutscene.
 Apan intro cutscene conditions are met when players reach the second floor of Ziggurat dungeon in Barahut chapter.
 If in the loaded save slot players have cleared the Ziggurat dungeon already, Apan intro cutscene will be played by going to any dungeon and returning home.
 Apan intro cutscene has less "weight" against main story cutscenes. If there are other cutscenes in the queue, Apan intro cutscene will not play till all of the important cutscenes are watched in the house. 
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/c2226595fe9b6aabc7d6e5ecea66117336a3d5b7.png

Development Roadmap Update 
On top of that, we have some new info about the upcoming updates! Here's the current state of our journey along the Development Roadmap:
1. Free Update #1: Shrine of Challenge - Visited on Feb 2nd, 2020.
2. Free Update #2: Setting Sun Inn - Visited on May 7th, 2020.
3. Free Update #3: Bergsons' House - Visited on June 24th, 2020.
4. Free Update #4: A Treasure! + Random Encounter Update (it's still a secret!)
5. Free Update #5: Temple of The Endless
6. Free Update #6: The Fellowship Sanctuary
7. Paid DLC Update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/8c1bc8432cb585d515e6a6f4fd7c42955a8e4042.jpg
CLICK HERE TO VIEW THE HIGHER RESOLUTION.

As you've noticed by now, even with a map in hand, sometimes we have to take detours and diverge from our original path. "Not all those who wander are lost", however. We absolutely still plan to deliver all the promised content, we just had to change the order of the updates and merge one with another.

That's all the news for today! We hope you like the new content. If you want to be up to date with all the Children of Morta news - be sure to follow @ChildrenOfMorta and @11bitstudios on Twitter!

Stay safe!
Dead Mage & 11 bit studios

notes.title: Setting Sun Inn - NEW GAME+ Added | Free Content Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/77310543526eba5179dd284db1e11d0c28753efd.jpg

Greetings, Fam!
It's great to see you all, gathered around the hearth of our humble Setting Sun Inn. Word has it that the brave Bergson family continues their journey along the Children of Morta development roadmap with the addition of the New Game+ Update. This free update includes - you've guessed it - New Game+ content with tons of additional lore in stunning new cutscenes and quests. So, don't be shy, join the family for another round - it’s on the house!

Watch the Setting Sun Inn Official Features Trailer here: 
https://youtu.be/enPt0EIWWlQ
We are super excited to deliver the second free content update from our Development Roadmap. As you could expect, the New Game+ Mode encourages you to follow the Bergson’s journey again, this time with an increase in difficulty, character skill point caps, and upgrades in both Ben’s workshop and Margaret’s lab.

We have also enriched the lore of the game with more than 50 new cutscenes, home events, and activities. We believe these additional pieces of story will strengthen your bond to the Bergson family and the wondrous world of Rea. In addition to the New Game+ content, new family-related quests have been added to the dungeons and will appear during the first playthrough as well. The update is available on all platforms: PC, Xbox One, PS4, and Nintendo Switch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/d9b5707fd75437e5d29cc55a367dbad0f742c8ff.png

General list of changes that we've introduced in the Setting Sun Inn Update: New Game Plus mode where players keep previously unlocked characters, skill tree progress, resources, Ben’s workshop and Book of Rea upgrades, all while playing through even more challenging content
 20 new cutscenes
 8 new Home Interactive Events to liven up the Bergson family home
 26 new Home Idle Activities to keep the Bergsons occupied 
 14 new Family Events and Quests in the Dungeons
 3 new Side Quest Traits
 Balance changes and bug fixes

If you are looking for even more details about the new content, you want to learn all the balance tweaks, all the cutscenes, you can find the full list below. However - it may include some very minor spoilers, and we know that some of you are very sensitive about that - that's why we decided not to share it in the list of the main features.

We hope you like the new content! Remember that's not our final word, though! We are still working on some new updates - be sure to follow us on Twitter/Facebook to be up to date with all the news. Oh, and we've just launched newsletter - so if that's your thing, you can subscribe here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11885669/1339a926795c5382b9e61b3a6ff9eb283b4aeef7.png

Detailed list of Setting Sun Inn Update changes:

notes.title: Build Version 0.17 Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Character Customization and Progression

Character Upgrade Menu Altered: A new ability tree designed to allow players to manually unlock and upgrade character abilities has replaced the previous system of automatically gaining abilities on level up.
Ability Runes Added. There are currently 5 - 6 runes for each ability slot of a character, each altering the way the ability behaves. Runes are dropped by dead enemies and can be found inside chests and other lootable objects during dungeon runs. All Ability Runes are removed upon returning home.
Inventory Slots Added: Each character can equip up to two items. Items are shared among the family and can be equipped to multiple characters at once.
Characters can now upgrade unique passive abilities.


Crafting and Resources

Schematics and Crafting Added: Ring and Amulet schematics can now be found during dungeon runs. A new menu at home allows Uncle Ben to craft and upgrade these items for Common and/or Rare Gems. Schematics are gained from resolving in-dungeon events, defeating bosses and Challenge Rooms as well as a small chance from opening chests.
Resource Altered: Crystals have been replaced by Common and Rare Gems. This new currency is used primarily in crafting and stacks between dungeon runs.
Resource Added: Souls are a special resource limited to one dungeon run that can now be harvested from dead enemies. Soul count resets upon returning home.
Destructibles Added: Destructible objects now exist in dungeons with a chance to release gems, health globes, and Ability Runes.


Events/Encounters

Small and Giant Chests Added: These new chests reward gems, health globes, and runes. Giant chests require a soul to unlock, but have a small chance to drop schematics.
Interactable Objects Added: New objects scattered throughout dungeons (dead corpses, broken wagons, etc.) can be interacted with a chance for an item of use to drop.
Sacred Shrines Added: Sacred Shrines now rest in dungeons. Activating them at the expense of Souls provides various temporary boosts.
Narrative Events and Quests Added: An additional four Narrative Events and Quests have been added to the Caeldippo Caves.
New Gameplay Event Added: A new puzzle-focused event can now be found.
Challenge Room Encounter Added: Challenge Rooms now have a chance to spawn a mini-boss instead of enemy waves. Mini-bosses are a weakened version of the previous Boss Monster.
Caeldippo Cave Boss Added: The rightful boss has now appeared, replacing his vicious minion!
Anai-Daya Chamber (Boss Room) Updated: The boss room has received a major visual upgrade to create a more epic environment to combat in!
Dark Corruption Portals Added: Corrupted portals have a small chance to appear from defeated enemies that continue to spawn Corrupted enemies in the location to keep a dungeon from ever feeling too safe.
Enemy Added: Dark Worm
Additional Environmental Hazard Combinations Added
Summoning Circles now appear more organically in the environment instead of in a particular room.


Bergson Home

Sanctuary Added: Dungeons are now accessible through portals in the Sanctuary below the Bergson’s house. The Sanctuary can be accessed by clicking on the fireplace in the house.
Mental Bubbles Added: Gain insight into the family's well being by clicking on them in the house to see their thoughts.


Misc

Improved Camera System: Improved performance for Event Rooms and special camera movements that now allow bosses and key objects to remain visible during encounters.
Better pixel perfect interpretation implemented for enhanced visuals and improved performance.
Various bugs and issues solved.
Numerous balance changes

Crafting and Resources

Schematics and Crafting Added: Ring and Amulet schematics can now be found during dungeon runs. A new menu at home allows Uncle Ben to craft and upgrade these items for Common and/or Rare Gems. Schematics are gained from resolving in-dungeon events, defeating bosses and Challenge Rooms as well as a small chance from opening chests.
Resource Altered: Crystals have been replaced by Common and Rare Gems. This new currency is used primarily in crafting and stacks between dungeon runs.
Resource Added: Souls are a special resource limited to one dungeon run that can now be harvested from dead enemies. Soul count resets upon returning home.
Destructibles Added: Destructible objects now exist in dungeons with a chance to release gems, health globes, and Ability Runes.


Events/Encounters

Small and Giant Chests Added: These new chests reward gems, health globes, and runes. Giant chests require a soul to unlock, but have a small chance to drop schematics.
Interactable Objects Added: New objects scattered throughout dungeons (dead corpses, broken wagons, etc.) can be interacted with a chance for an item of use to drop.
Sacred Shrines Added: Sacred Shrines now rest in dungeons. Activating them at the expense of Souls provides various temporary boosts.
Narrative Events and Quests Added: An additional four Narrative Events and Quests have been added to the Caeldippo Caves.
New Gameplay Event Added: A new puzzle-focused event can now be found.
Challenge Room Encounter Added: Challenge Rooms now have a chance to spawn a mini-boss instead of enemy waves. Mini-bosses are a weakened version of the previous Boss Monster.
Caeldippo Cave Boss Added: The rightful boss has now appeared, replacing his vicious minion!
Anai-Daya Chamber (Boss Room) Updated: The boss room has received a major visual upgrade to create a more epic environment to combat in!
Dark Corruption Portals Added: Corrupted portals have a small chance to appear from defeated enemies that continue to spawn Corrupted enemies in the location to keep a dungeon from ever feeling too safe.
Enemy Added: Dark Worm
Additional Environmental Hazard Combinations Added
Summoning Circles now appear more organically in the environment instead of in a particular room.


Bergson Home

Sanctuary Added: Dungeons are now accessible through portals in the Sanctuary below the Bergson’s house. The Sanctuary can be accessed by clicking on the fireplace in the house.
Mental Bubbles Added: Gain insight into the family's well being by clicking on them in the house to see their thoughts.


Misc

Improved Camera System: Improved performance for Event Rooms and special camera movements that now allow bosses and key objects to remain visible during encounters.
Better pixel perfect interpretation implemented for enhanced visuals and improved performance.
Various bugs and issues solved.
Numerous balance changes
